entry.tagline: No sign-up, no login. Pick a nickname and start chatting.
entry.helperPrefilled: 1 to 20 characters, any language. We filled in the one you used last time.

convs.title: Chats
convs.emptyHint: Click someone in the online list and choose “Invite to private chat”

chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.peerOfflineLong: Offline · the chat ends automatically after 30 minutes
chat.inputDisabledHint: The input is disabled. Press “Close” to remove this window.

system.chatStarted: Your private chat with {{name}} has started

ended.peerTimeout: {{name}} was offline for over 30 minutes, so the chat ended

invite.from: {{name}} invites you to a private chat
invite.declined: {{name}} declined your invitation · you can invite them again in 30 minutes
invite.busy: {{name}} is busy right now · try again later

photo.preview: Preview of the photo to send
photo.caption: {{name}} · {{time}} · click the background, press ✕ or Esc to close
photo.failed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

leaveDlg.title: Leave the chat room?
leaveDlg.body: If you leave, all your private chats end and your nickname is released for others. Are you sure?

recallDlg.title: Recall this message?
recallDlg.body: Nobody will be able to see it, and it can’t be undone.

endDlg.title: End your chat with {{name}}?
endDlg.body: Messages and photos in this chat will be deleted.

notice.sessionExpired: You were offline too long and your nickname was released. Please enter again.

errors.NICKNAME_TAKEN: That nickname is already in use. Please pick another
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You’re sending too fast. Wait {{sec}} s
errors.DUPLICATE_CONTENT: Please don’t send the same thing again and again
errors.IMAGE_RATE_LIMITED: Sending photos too fast. Try again in {{sec}} s
errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The photo is still over 2 MB after compression. Choose a smaller one
errors.IMAGE_TYPE: That format isn’t supported. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP.
errors.INVITE_COOLDOWN: They just declined your invitation. You can invite again in {{time}}
errors.INVITE_RATE_LIMITED: Please wait a bit before inviting again
errors.INVITE_PENDING: You already invited this person. Waiting for a reply
errors.ALREADY_CHATTING: You already have a private chat with this person
errors.NOT_ENTERED: Please enter the chat room first
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again
